record.question: Commonest causes of first trimester miscarriage is
record.explanation: The most common cause of first-trimester miscarriage is chromosomal abnormalities in the conceptus, accounting for ~50–60% of cases, but this is not among the options. Among the listed anatomical/structural causes, uterine malformation (e.g., septate uterus) is a recognized cause of first-trimester loss. Cervical incompetence (option index 2) typically causes painless second-trimester loss, making it less consistent with the question stem. Fibroid (option index 1) can contribute but is less specifically linked as the commonest cause in standard texts.
